title: FundFire features David Perla on legal challenges tied to energy transition investments
summary: FundFire features Burford Vice Chair David Perla in an article entitled "Energy Transition Funds Face Legal Snags from Shifting Policy Backdrop." Learn more.
body_markdown:
FundFire features Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) in an article entitled "Energy Transition Funds Face Legal Snags from Shifting Policy Backdrop."


The article states: "Contractual obligations and breaches of them are a primary source of disputes because of the still-idiosyncratic ways that energy transition investments materialize, David Perla, co-chief operating officer at Burford, told FundFire."


Read the full article[here](https://www.fundfire.com/c/4830804/656014) .
